cpu_only_ci_testing.description: Pattern for forcing CPU-only execution in CI environments without GPU

key_techniques: Set framework-specific device environment variables (e.g., TORCH_DEVICE='cpu')
Create session-scoped pytest fixtures to enforce CPU device

Ensures consistent test execution across environments

graceful_zero_test_handling.description: Pattern for handling pytest exit code 2 when zero tests match a marker
graceful_zero_test_handling.applicability: CI workflows that use pytest markers with optional test implementations
graceful_zero_test_handling.problem: pytest returns exit code 2 (collection errors) instead of exit code 5 (no tests) when collection errors exist
solution: Check exit code equality across runs (determinism)
Parse logs for '0 selected' or similar patterns
Exit 0 (success) with informative warning when zero tests matched
benefits: Workflows don't fail when tests not yet implemented
Future-proof for when tests are added
